shared_elements: low-relief carved figures arranged in horizontal registers/rows
animal forms (small animal signs in A; rams in B)
justification: Both surfaces show human figures rendered in profile in low relief and organised along horizontal lines, and both include animal forms, but these are generic conventions found in almost any relief tradition. A is overwhelmingly a dense field of small pictographic signs beneath a single tiny adoration register topped by a winged disc, while B is a large-scale procession of bearded men leading horned rams — no shared specific motif, attribute or relationship.
